_doc: List prices used ONLY to compute tushen.cost_usd on traced model calls (USD per 1M tokens). cost = cache_hit_in*p_hit + (in - cache_hit_in)*p_miss + out*p_out, all /1e6. Checked 2026-10-27 (NZDT). Prices change; re-check the source before quoting. A model missing here gets cost null (never guessed).

deepseek/deepseek-flash.note: listed values are OFF-PEAK; peak = 2x (01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC Mon-Fri). Chinese public holidays (all off-peak) are not modelled. Cache hit tokens = usage.prompt_cache_hit_tokens.
